card.name: Having a place or role in something
card.fires_on: The word 'place' or 'role' (or the 'no'/'a'/'have' just before it) after 'has/have' when saying whether something belongs or has a part, as in 'has no place in'.

modes.example: also have a<< role>> in some circumstances: for example, the

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with 'role' or 'place', finishing phrases like 'has a role in' or 'has no place in'.
card.plain: It fires when a sentence is about to say that something does or does not have a place or role somewhere.
